initial_program.rationale: Simple pick-and-place: query cube and pad positions, approach from above, grasp cube, lift, transport above pad, lower, release, and retreat. Uses only allowed primitives with no imports and no unneeded randomness.

repair_proposal.rationale: Failure at mass=1.0 with force=10 indicates grip slip / failed lift. Grasp at +0.02 was too high for stable pinch and lift at 0.15 with fast steps risks slip. Fix: deeper grasp (+0.005), max close force 100 to hold 1kg with friction 0.8, slower high lift (+0.20, steps=100) for stable transport, and low gentle placement (+0.02) to avoid drop bounce causing -0.22 margin.
